default.description: default capability set for the main window and the per-instance editor windows (label `edit-<id>`, see open_edit_window in lib.rs). The editor windows are listed here because a window absent from every capability cannot invoke at all — it would open and then fail to load anything. They get one permission the main window does not need, `core:window:allow-close`, so the editor's Cancel/Save can dismiss its own window; nothing here lets the frontend create a window, because open_edit_window builds them in Rust.
